invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: Invoices issued through Stripe across all workspaces. Amounts are shown in each invoice’s own currency.
invoices.caption: All invoices
invoices.credit_hint: Credit notes are issued from paid and open invoices: void invoices were never charged, drafts can still be edited.

empty.title: No invoices yet
empty.description: Invoices appear here as soon as Stripe issues them for a workspace.

credit_notes.title: Credit notes
credit_notes.description: Credits and Stripe refunds issued to customers. To issue one, open the invoice it corrects.
credit_notes.caption: All credit notes
credit_notes.legend: Credit to balance reduces the next invoice · Refund to card sends money back · Before or after payment corrects an invoice Stripe issued

empty.title: No credit notes yet
empty.description: Credit notes are issued from the invoice they correct.

stats.label: Billing figures
stats.awaiting_payment_detail: {count} open invoice · {retries} with a retry scheduled | {count} open invoices · {retries} with a retry scheduled
stats.credited_this_month_detail: {count} credit note · {refunded} refunded | {count} credit notes · {refunded} refunded

credit_modal.title: Issue credit note

mode.reduce_amount_due_description: The open invoice asks less; nothing is refunded

credit_modal.above_ceiling_credited: At most {max}: {credited} was already credited on {numbers}.

outcome.empty: Enter an amount to see what the customer gets.
outcome.credit_to_balance: {workspace} receives {amount} as balance credit, deducted from {nextInvoice}.
outcome.refund: {amount} goes back to {card}; the customer sees it in 5–10 days.
outcome.total: {number} is then credited {credited} of {total} in all.

credit_modal.creates: Creates a credit note in Stripe.

refund_confirm.title: Refund {amount} to {card}?
refund_confirm.description: This can’t be undone. The customer sees it in 5–10 days.

credit_modal.success_description: It appears in the lists once Stripe confirms it, in a few seconds.
credit_modal.error: The credit note could not be issued.
credit_modal.load_failed: The invoice could not be loaded.

blocked.draft: Drafts can still be edited. Credit becomes possible once Stripe finalises the invoice.
blocked.void: Void invoices were never charged, so there is nothing to credit.
blocked.uncollectible: This invoice was written off: nothing was collected to credit.
blocked.fully_credited: This invoice has already been credited in full.

billing_rules.title: Billing rules & legal
billing_rules.description: What happens when a payment fails, who can get a refund, and the documents customers accept. Changes apply to every workspace from the next billing event.

unpaid.title: Unpaid invoices
unpaid.description: When a renewal can’t be charged, Stripe retries the card. If it still fails, the workspace is suspended.
unpaid.suspend_description: Members lose access; data and files are kept. Paying the invoice restores access immediately.
unpaid.suspend_days_description: Counted from the first failed payment.
unpaid.retention_days_description: Cancelled workspaces can still export during this time. Then everything is deleted for good; invoices stay archived.

steps.failed_effect: Workspace owner emailed, banner in the app
steps.retries_effect: Access unchanged; retries follow your Stripe settings
steps.not_suspended_effect: Access continues while the invoice stays unpaid
steps.deleted_effect: Only if the workspace owner cancels; invoices stay archived

free.title: Free workspaces
free.description: Limits abuse of the free plan by tying each free workspace to a payment card.
free.per_card_description: Once a card backs this many free workspaces, another one with the same card asks for a paid plan.
free.per_card_hint: From 0 to 100. 0 turns the rule off.

tax.title: Tax
tax.description: Stripe calculates VAT from the customer’s country using the product’s tax category.
tax.code_description: Applied to every plan when it’s synced to Stripe.
tax.code_hint: txcd_ followed by 8 digits. txcd_10000000 is “General – electronically supplied services”.
tax.plans_summary_synced: {synced} of {total} plans carry this category · last sync {date}
tax.plans_not_configured: Stripe is not configured: plans are not synced.
tax.unsaved_code: Save first: the new category reaches the plans once it is saved.
tax.resync_failed: The plans could not be synced with Stripe.

refunds.title: Refund policy
refunds.description: Two separate rules: refunds that workspace owners request themselves, and automatic refunds when they cancel mid-cycle.
refunds.guarantee_description: Workspace owners see a “Request a refund” button in Billing while the window is open.
refunds.window_description: Counted from the first paid invoice.

mode.full_description: Everything paid on the first invoice
mode.prorated_description: Only the days not used yet

worked_example.scenario: A plan at {price} / month. The workspace owner asks for a refund on day {day} of {days}.

refunds.on_cancel_description: Separate from the guarantee: when a workspace owner cancels mid-cycle, the unused days are refunded automatically, without a request.

legal.title: Legal documents
legal.description: Published on public pages and linked from sign-up and the footer of every email.

billing.issue_credit_note_description: Credit an invoice to the customer’s balance or refund it to their card
billing.invoice_stats_description: See what awaits payment, what was collected, credited and written off
billing.credit_note_stats_description: See what was credited and refunded this month
billing.billing_rules_description: Change dunning, free workspace, tax and refund rules, and publish the legal documents
